quarterly_data.signal: L3Harris 10-Q (quarter ended July 3, 2026): contractual backlog $42.0 billion, with approximately 40% expected to be recognized within twelve months and 65% within twenty-four months; segment backlog Space & Mission Systems $22,431 million (year-ago $16,282 million), Communications & Spectrum Dominance $9,031 million ($9,437 million) and Missile Solutions $10,531 million ($9,661 million). Missile Solutions Q2 revenue $1,054 million, up 14%, at a 12.3% operating margin; Space & Mission Systems first-half revenue up 15% on an ISR material-procurement milestone for classified contracts, missionized aircraft, Space Development Agency Tracking Tranche 3 and FAA volume. First-half capital expenditures were $207 million and Q2 company-funded R&D $160 million; proceeds of the Department of War investment in the Missile Solutions subsidiary are to fund development and construction to expand missile manufacturing capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog $42.0 billion; SMS backlog $22,431 million; MSL Q2 revenue $1,054 million (+14%)
